title: Forms, Context and CRUD
description: Controlled and accessible forms, sharing state with Context, creating, editing and deleting records against the project API, handling submission errors, and UI tests with Testing Library queries by role and label.
sourceCoverageNotes: Second-mate grouping decision, not syllabus: Standard days S32 (Lab, 'Forms and shared state') and S33 (Project, 'CRUD screens and UI tests'). Fast teaches these topics across FT18 (four rows), FT19 row 0 (Sharing state with Context) and FT20 row 0 (UI tests with Testing Library).
